title: Second-Level Concavity of the Riemann $Ξ$ Kernel
summary: Let $Φ$ be the classical Jacobi-theta kernel in the Fourier representation of the Riemann $Ξ$-function, set $s(t)=Φ(\sqrt t)$, and define the first Laguerre expression $f(t)=s'(t)^2-s(t)s''(t)$. Csordas and Dimitrov (2000) conjectured that $\log f$ is strictly concave on $(0,\infty)$; Csordas (2015) later restated the assertion as Open Problem~4.14. We prove the conjecture by two complementary methods, sharing only a local certificate near the modular fixed point.
